These facts and inferences converge on the hypothesis that the institution has an active initiative in the relevant problem domain.

section5_vardhanCapability.name: AER-KEP-Q — Asynchronous Exposure-Resilient Key Establishment
section5_vardhanCapability.description: Epoch-based key establishment protocol with automatic quarantine on exposure detection and fresh epoch reissuance, persisting state across restarts with Raft-backed HA.
section5_vardhanCapability.technicalMechanism: ML-KEM-1024 + ML-DSA-87 + Ed25519 dual-signing, transaction-bound HKDF, per-epoch replay protection
section5_vardhanCapability.relevanceToProblem: Relevant to CRYPTOGRAPHIC_AGILITY, KEY_LIFECYCLE, INCIDENT_RESPONSE, TRUST_BOUNDARY

section5_vardhanCapability.name: pq_shield — Quantum-Safe Network Proxy
section5_vardhanCapability.description: Post-quantum TLS-terminating reverse proxy with ML-KEM-1024 + XKyber key exchange, providing ingress security for legacy workloads.
section5_vardhanCapability.technicalMechanism: ML-KEM-1024 + ML-DSA-87 handshake, AEAD transport, concurrency limiting, Raft-backed HA
section5_vardhanCapability.relevanceToProblem: Relevant to CRYPTOGRAPHIC_AGILITY, TRUST_BOUNDARY, SECURITY_SEGMENTATION, INCIDENT_RESPONSE

section5_vardhanCapability.name: Key Lifecycle Management
section5_vardhanCapability.description: Formal key lifecycle state machine (Active → Rotating → Deprecated → Retired → Revoked) with time-based deprecation and secure destruction.
section5_vardhanCapability.technicalMechanism: State machine with is_valid_transition(), TTL-based deprecation, secure on-disk destruction

section5_vardhanCapability.name: Exposure-Alert Pipeline
section5_vardhanCapability.description: Cryptographic exposure detection with pluggable alert sinks and automatic epoch quarantine trigger.
section5_vardhanCapability.technicalMechanism: Pluggable AlertSink trait, AlertSeverity enum (INFO→CRITICAL), epoch quarantine integration
